item.title: Hakeem Jeffries is poised to become the first Black speaker of the House
item.description: As speaker, the New York Democrat would be second in the presidential line of succession, after the vice president. He has vowed to focus on affordability and holding the administration accountable.
item.content:encoded:
As speaker, the New York Democrat would be second in the presidential line of succession, after the vice president. He has vowed to focus on affordability and holding the administration accountable.

(Image credit: Alex Wong)

item.title: These 9 candidates for governor made history in the 2026 election
item.description: Voters on Tuesday elected the nation's first Black woman governor and the nation's first Native American woman governor.
item.content:encoded:
Voters on Tuesday elected the nation's first Black woman governor and the nation's first Native American woman governor.

item.title: 'We have great leverage here': DNC chair Ken Martin on Democrats' midterms sweep
item.description: Democrats flipped Senate seats in Republican strongholds and won control of Congress. DNC chair Ken Martin explains why he believes voters gave his party a mandate and what comes next.
item.content:encoded:
Democrats flipped Senate seats in Republican strongholds and won control of Congress. DNC chair Ken Martin explains why he believes voters gave his party a mandate and what comes next.

(Image credit: Stephen Maturen)
item.dc:creator: Steve Inskeep

item.title: Nevada Attorney General Aaron Ford beats GOP incumbent for governor
item.description: Democrat Aaron Ford defeated Republican Gov. Joe Lombardo. He's set to become Nevada's first Black governor.
item.content:encoded:
Democrat Aaron Ford defeated Republican Gov. Joe Lombardo. He's set to become Nevada's first Black governor.

(Image credit: Ethan Miller)
item.dc:creator: Lucia Starbuck

item.title: Democrat Abdul El-Sayed defeats Republican Mike Rogers in key Michigan Senate race
item.description: El-Sayed's campaign tested how an antiestablishment candidate on the left would fare in a perennial Midwest battleground. With the win, he'll become the first Muslim American to serve in the Senate.
item.content:encoded:
El-Sayed's campaign tested how an antiestablishment candidate on the left would fare in a perennial Midwest battleground. With the win, he'll become the first Muslim American to serve in the Senate.

item.title: Troy Jackson wins Maine Senate race over Susan Collins, in big victory for Democrats
item.description: The result is a crucial victory for Democrats in their push to retake the Senate majority, flipping a seat that Collins has held for nearly 30 years.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Democrats win full control of Congress, ushering in a new era of divided government
item.description: The victories in the House and Senate return Democrats to full control of Congress for the first time since 2023 and deepens the level of expected friction between them and President Trump.
item.content:encoded:
